name: SideNavigation
intro: Build a nested side navigation with List, ListItem, and Link. Items renders nested lists from an item tree.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: Set a navigation label when the page has multiple navigation landmarks.

parts.name: List
parts.description: Nest another List inside ListItem for child destinations.

parts.name: ListItem
parts.description: Contains a link and optional nested List.

parts.name: Link
parts.description: Set href to the destination and isCurrent for the active page.

props.name: isCurrent
props.description: Marks this link as the current page.

parts.name: Items
parts.description: Renders nested lists from item data.

props.name: items
props.description: Tree of labels, hrefs, current-page flags, and child items.

accessibility: Give Root a useful navigation label when the page has more than one navigation landmark.
